items.headline: Manchester United lose Manchester Derby to City amid controversial refereeing
items.summary: Manchester United fell 1-0 to Manchester City in a contentious derby featuring refereeing errors. The match saw Phil Foden sent off in controversial circumstances.

items.headline: Baleba completes Brighton transfer, trains at Carrington
items.summary: Carlos Baleba has joined Manchester United from Brighton. He trained at Carrington but is yet to make his competitive debut.

items.headline: Three academy players sign professional contracts for 2026/27 season
items.summary: Manchester United handed professional contracts to three academy players for the 2026/27 season, with Noah Ajayi close to agreement on his first pro deal.

items.headline: Carrick insists Manchester Derby defeat will not change season trajectory
items.summary: Manager Michael Carrick addressed the Manchester Derby loss, stating the setback will not alter Manchester United's season plans ahead of upcoming fixtures.

items.headline: Real Madrid reportedly pushing for academy prospect JJ Gabriel
items.summary: Real Madrid are targeting Manchester United academy player JJ Gabriel, who recently indicated frustration over lack of first-team opportunities.
